deficiencies.description: The rewrite converts the lecturer's pointing words ('the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus') into a spatial description ('lies next to the outer surface') that the text does not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The word 'circumspect' was changed to 'circumscribed' without a term correction, choosing a likely reading to correct an erroneous or unclear word in the text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: this is actually circumspect and very separate
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour is therefore circumscribed and very separate

considerations.reason: The rewrite renders this into passive textbook prose ('the tumour is movable, and it can literally be scooped out with no damage to the surrounding tissue') while preserving the exact meaning.
